privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Sellah collects, uses, stores, and shares information when you use our website, mobile applications, and related services (together, the “Services”). By using the Services, you agree to this policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the Services.
privacy.whoP1: Sellah operates a marketplace platform connecting buyers and sellers of local brands, primarily in Egypt. This policy applies to visitors of our marketing site and to users of the Sellah apps and accounts.
privacy.whoP2: For data protection requests, contact us at the email shown on our Support page. You should have a lawyer review this policy for your jurisdiction and how your product actually works before submitting to app stores.
privacy.collectIntro: Depending on how you use Sellah, we may collect:
privacy.collectLi1: Account & profile: name, email address, mobile number, password or authentication tokens, profile photo, and role (buyer or seller).
privacy.collectLi2: Store & commerce: shop name, branding, product listings, prices, inventory, photos, order history, shipping addresses, and messages needed to complete orders.
privacy.collectLi3: Payments & transactions: transaction references, payment status, and limited billing-related information processed by payment partners—we do not store full card numbers on our servers when partners tokenize cards.
privacy.collectLi4: Device & technical: device type, OS version, app version, IP address, language, diagnostics, crash logs, and similar data used to secure and improve the Services.
privacy.collectLi5: Usage & support: in-app activity you generate, customer support conversations, and feedback you submit.
privacy.collectLi6: Sign-in partners: if you use Sign in with Apple, Google, or similar, we receive identifiers and profile details allowed by that provider.
privacy.useLi1: Provide and improve the marketplace, accounts, listings, checkout, and order tracking.
privacy.useLi2: Process payments, prevent fraud and abuse, verify sellers, and enforce our Terms.
privacy.useLi3: Send service messages, security alerts, and (where allowed) product updates—you can control marketing preferences in the app where applicable.
privacy.useLi4: Comply with law, respond to lawful requests, and protect our users and business.
privacy.shareLi1: Other users as needed for the marketplace—for example, buyers and sellers see order details required to fulfil an order.
privacy.shareLi2: Service providers that host infrastructure, send email or push notifications, process payments, prevent fraud, or provide analytics—bound by contracts and only instructed for limited purposes.
privacy.shareLi3: Authorities when required by law or to protect rights, safety, and security.
privacy.shareLi4: A successor if we are involved in a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, subject to reasonable safeguards.
privacy.retentionP: We keep information as long as your account is active and as needed to provide the Services, resolve disputes, comply with law, and enforce agreements. Some data may remain in backups for a limited period. When deletion is not technically immediate, we aim to restrict use meanwhile.
privacy.rightsIntro: Depending on applicable law, you may have rights to:
privacy.rightsLi1: Access or receive a copy of certain personal data.
privacy.rightsLi3: Request deletion or restriction of processing where applicable.
privacy.rightsLi4: Object to certain processing or withdraw consent where processing is consent-based.
privacy.rightsFooter: To exercise these rights, email us from our Support page. We may need to verify your identity before responding.
privacy.securityP: We use technical and organizational measures designed to protect information. No method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure; we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.childrenP: The Services are not intended for children under the age required by local law (typically 13 or older, subject to your region). We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.
privacy.transfersP: We may process data in Egypt and other countries where our providers operate. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards for cross-border transfers.
privacy.changesP: We may update this policy from time to time. We will post the updated version with a new “Last updated” date and, where appropriate, notify you in the app or by email.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern your access to and use of Sellah’s website, applications, and services. By creating an account or using the Services, you agree to these Terms.
terms.eligibilityP1: You must be able to form a binding contract under applicable law. You are responsible for accurate registration information and for keeping credentials secure.
terms.eligibilityP2: We may refuse or close accounts that violate these Terms, pose risk, or misuse the platform.
terms.marketplaceP1: Sellah provides a platform for buyers and sellers to discover products, communicate order-related information, and checkout where enabled. Sellers are independent from Sellah; they are responsible for their listings, inventory, pricing, shipping, taxes where applicable, and compliance with law.
terms.marketplaceP2: Sellah may facilitate payments or order flow as described in the product—but unless expressly stated otherwise in writing, Sellah is not the seller of third-party goods.
terms.buyersLi1: Provide accurate delivery and contact details.
terms.buyersLi2: Pay amounts shown at checkout according to the payment flow.
terms.buyersLi3: Use dispute and support channels in good faith; abusive behaviour or charge abuse may lead to suspension.
terms.sellersLi1: List only products you can lawfully sell; descriptions, photos, and prices must be accurate.
terms.sellersLi2: Fulfil paid orders promptly and communicate delays honestly.
terms.sellersLi3: Comply with consumer protection, tax, and e-commerce rules that apply to you in Egypt or other markets where you operate.
terms.sellersLi4: Pay applicable commissions or fees as disclosed in the seller experience.
terms.prohibitedLi1: List counterfeit, unsafe, illegal, or stolen goods; harass users; or circumvent checkout.
terms.prohibitedLi2: Scrape, overload, or attempt to hack the Services.
terms.prohibitedLi4: Use the Services for money laundering, fraud, or sanctions evasion.
terms.ipP: Sellah and its licensors own the Sellah brands, software, and content we create. You retain rights in content you upload; you grant us a licence to host, display, and process that content to operate the Services.
terms.disclaimersP1: The Services are provided “as is” to the maximum extent permitted by law. We do not warrant uninterrupted or error-free operation.
terms.disclaimersP2: To the extent permitted by applicable law, Sellah is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for loss of profits, data, or goodwill. Our aggregate liability arising out of these Terms or the Services is limited to the greater of amounts you paid us in fees in the twelve months before the claim or fifty U.S. dollars—unless the law of your jurisdiction does not allow such a cap.
terms.disputesP: Buyers and sellers should try to resolve issues directly. Where Sellah offers dispute tools or support, those processes are supplementary and do not replace your legal rights.
terms.lawP: Unless mandatory consumer laws where you live say otherwise, these Terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt, and courts in Egypt have jurisdiction—subject to updates you may agree to for specific programmes.
terms.terminationP: You may stop using the Services at any time. We may suspend or terminate access for breach, risk, or legal reasons. Provisions that by nature should survive will survive termination.
terms.termsContactP: Questions about these Terms: use the contact information on our Support page.

support.title: Help & Support
support.lead: We’re here for buyers, sellers, and partners using Sellah. Use the options below to reach us or browse common questions.
support.emailBody: For account access, orders, seller verification, and general questions, write to:
support.responseTime: We aim to respond within a few business days; complex cases may take longer.
support.legalLinksBody: Official policies for the Sellah apps and website:
support.faq1A: Sellah is a marketplace platform focused on local brands in Egypt—helping buyers shop with clearer product information and safer checkout than selling only through direct messages.
support.faq2Q: How do I report a problem with an order?
support.faq2A: Contact us by email with your order ID, store name, and a short description. We may ask for screenshots or delivery proof to help resolve the issue.
support.faq3A: Refund eligibility depends on the seller’s policies, the condition of the item, and the payment flow used. Our team can explain options once we review your case.
support.faq4Q: How do I delete my account or data?
support.faq4A: Email us from the address associated with your account and ask for account closure or data rights. We will verify ownership and respond as required by applicable law.
support.faq5A: Sellah may charge sellers commissions or fees on successful sales as described in the seller experience—pricing can change with notice where required.
support.faq6Q: Where can I read the full Privacy Policy and Terms?
support.faq6A: Use the links under “Legal & policies” on this page for the current versions.
